evaluation_contract.authority: This release fixes target IDs and source bytes. Preparation artifacts keep their historical pending/freezing flags; those flags do not authorize runtime scoring independently of this contract.
evaluation_contract.unit: One canonical narrow target with all mandatory object/relationship/location context. Supporting numbers alone do not match. Score technical, question and negative routes separately.
evaluation_contract.full_input_profile: All six declared primary MD/PDF/block inventories, graphic viewing, calculation capability, and equal access to primary manufacturer/normative sources for both variants. TEXT authority remains mandatory.
evaluation_contract.availability: The fixed full-input denominators are84technical,198questions,77negative. If necessary evidence is inaccessible, record target-level availability and report incomplete comparability. Do not silently drop targets after seeing outputs or call unavailable evidence a model miss. Any alternative denominator is preregistered as a new profile, with the full-set result retained.
evaluation_contract.external_evidence: Archived external observations retain access dates and limits. No claim that URLs remain accessible or that all snapshots are local. General equal source access is required; answer-bearing targeted URLs are evaluator-only.
evaluation_contract.positive_matching: Match meaning and source identity, allowing different wording; keep partial coverage and unsupported additions separate. No extra credit for duplicate outputs or aliases.
evaluation_contract.negative_matching: For filter acceptance, prove candidate reached the filter and was removed for the correct reason; silence alone proves neither filter operation nor improvement.
evaluation_contract.retention: Baseline source IDs remain attached. Confirmed useful findings must survive with mandatory details; questions remain separate. New valid findings outside the frozen dataset require separate adjudication, not automatic rejection.
evaluation_contract.isolation: Independent discovery has no access to this package, history or engineer answers. Seal outputs before evaluation; known six projects remain exposed regression cases.
evaluation_contract.versioning: Never rewrite this release in place after running comparisons. A changed verdict or target requires a new release and explicit result version.
